1.english_reference: Ahaz [ was ] twenty years old when he began to reign

traditions.WLC: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ אָחָ֣ז בְּ מָלְכ֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: Εἴκοσι ἐτῶν Ἀχὰς ἐν τῷ βασιλεῦσαι αὐτόν ,
traditions.VUL: Vigínti annórum erat Achaz cum regnáre cœpísset ,
traditions.KJV: Ahaz [ was ] twenty years old when he began to reign ,

1.english_reference: and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וְ שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ δέκα ἓξ ἔτη ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ ·
traditions.VUL: et sédecim annis regnávit in Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem :

1.english_reference: but he did not [ that which was ] right in the sight of the LORD , like David his father

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹא עָשָׂ֧ה הַ יָּשָׁ֛ר בְּ עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה כְּ דָוִ֥יד אָבִֽי ו
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἐποίησεν τὸ εὐθὲς ἐνώπιον Κυρίου ὡς Δαυεὶδ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: Non fecit rectum in conspéctu Dómini sicut David pater eius :
traditions.KJV: but he did not [ that which was ] right in the sight of the LORD , like David his father :

2.english_reference: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֕לֶךְ בְּ דַרְכֵ֖י מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπορεύθη κατὰ τὰς ὁδοὺς βασιλέως Ἰσραήλ ·
traditions.VUL: sed ambulávit in viis regum Israel ,
traditions.KJV: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel ,

2.english_reference: and made also molten images for Baalim

traditions.WLC: וְ גַ֧ם מַסֵּכ֛וֹת עָשָׂ֖ה לַ בְּעָלִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ γὰρ γλυπτὰ ἐποίησεν ἐν τοῖς εἰδώλοις αὐτῶν ·
traditions.VUL: ínsuper et státuas fudit Báalim .
traditions.KJV: and made also molten images for Baalim .

3.english_reference: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom

traditions.WLC: וְ ה֥וּא הִקְטִ֖יר בְּ גֵ֣יא בֶן הִנֹּ֑ם
traditions.LXX: ἔθυεν ἐν Γαιβενθὸμ
traditions.VUL: Ipse est , qui adolévit incénsum in valle Benénnom ,
traditions.KJV: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom ,

3.english_reference: and burnt his children in the fire

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּבְעֵ֤ר אֶת בָּנָי ו֙ בָּ אֵ֔שׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ διῆγεν τὰ τέκνα αὐτοῦ διὰ πυρὸς
traditions.VUL: et lustrávit fílios suos in igne ,
traditions.KJV: and burnt his children in the fire ,

3.english_reference: after the abominations of the heathen whom the LORD had cast out before the children of Israel

traditions.WLC: כְּ תֹֽעֲבוֹת֙ הַ גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הֹרִ֣ישׁ יְהוָ֔ה מִ פְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰ βδελύγματα τῶν ἐθνῶν ὧν ἐξωλέθρευσεν Κύριος ἀπὸ προσώπου υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: iuxta ritum géntium , quas interfécit Dóminus in advéntu filiórum Israel .
traditions.KJV: after the abominations of the heathen whom the LORD had cast out before the children of Israel .

4.english_reference: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places

traditions.WLC: וַ יְזַבֵּ֧חַ וַ יְקַטֵּ֛ר בַּ בָּמ֖וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐθυμία ἐπὶ τῶν ὑψηλῶν
traditions.VUL: Sacrificábat quoque , et thymiáma succendébat in excélsis ,
traditions.KJV: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places ,

traditions.WLC: וְ עַל הַ גְּבָע֑וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν δωμάτων
traditions.VUL: et in cóllibus ,
traditions.KJV: and on the hills ,

traditions.WLC: וְ תַ֖חַת כָּל עֵ֥ץ רַעֲנָֽן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὑποκάτω παντὸς ξύλου ἀλσώδους .
traditions.VUL: et sub omni ligno frondóso .
traditions.KJV: and under every green tree .

5.english_reference: Wherefore the LORD his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּתְּנֵ֜ הוּ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָי ו֮ בְּ יַ֣ד מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָם֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτὸν Κύριος ὁ θεὸς αὐτοῦ διὰ χειρὸς βασιλέων Συρίας ,
traditions.VUL: Tradidítque eum Dóminus Deus eius in manu regis Sýriæ ,
traditions.KJV: Wherefore the LORD his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria ;

5.english_reference: and they smote him , and carried away a great multitude of them captives , and brought [ them ] to Damascus

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֨כּוּ ב֔ וֹ וַ יִּשְׁבּ֤וּ מִמֶּ֨ נּוּ֙ שִׁבְיָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה וַ יָּבִ֖יאוּ דַּרְמָ֑שֶׂק
traditions.LXX: ἐπάταξεν ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ ᾐχμαλώτευσαν ἐξ αὐτῶν αἰχμαλωσίαν πολλήν ·
traditions.VUL: qui percússit eum , magnámque prædam cepit de eius império , et addúxit in Damáscum :
traditions.KJV: and they smote him , and carried away a great multitude of them captives , and brought [ them ] to Damascus .

5.english_reference: And he was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel , who smote him with a great slaughter

traditions.WLC: וְ֠ גַם בְּ יַד מֶ֤לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נִתָּ֔ן וַ יַּךְ בּ֖ וֹ מַכָּ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ γὰρ εἰς τὰς χεῖρας βασιλέων Ἰσραὴλ παρέδωκεν αὐτόν , ἐπάταξεν ἑαυτῷ πληγὴν μεγάλην .
traditions.VUL: mánibus quoque regis Israel tráditus est , et percússus plaga grandi .
traditions.KJV: And he was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel , who smote him with a great slaughter .

6.english_reference: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Judah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּהֲרֹג֩ פֶּ֨קַח בֶּן רְמַלְיָ֜הוּ בִּֽ יהוּדָ֗ה מֵאָ֨ה וְ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף בְּ י֥וֹם אֶחָ֖ד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Φάκεε ὁ τοῦ Ῥομελιὰ βασιλεὺς Ἰσραὴλ ἐν μιᾷ ἡμέρᾳ ἑκατὸν εἴκοσι χιλιάδας
traditions.VUL: Occidítque Phácee fílius Romelíæ de Iuda centum vigínti míllia in die uno ,
traditions.KJV: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Judah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day , [ which were ]

traditions.WLC: הַ כֹּ֣ל בְּנֵי חָ֑יִל
traditions.LXX: ἀνδρῶν δυνατῶν ἰσχύι ,
traditions.VUL: omnes viros bellatóres :
traditions.KJV: all valiant men ;

6.english_reference: because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers

traditions.WLC: בְּ עָזְבָ֕ ם אֶת יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתָֽ ם
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῷ αὐτοὺς καταλιπεῖν τὸν κύριον θεὸν τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: eo quod reliquíssent Dóminum Deum patrum suórum .
traditions.KJV: because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers .

7.english_reference: And Zichri , a mighty man of Ephraim , slew Maaseiah the king ’s son

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יַּהֲרֹ֞ג זִכְרִ֣י גִּבּ֣וֹר אֶפְרַ֗יִם אֶת מַעֲשֵׂיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν Ἐζεκρεὶ ὁ δυνατὸς τοῦ Ἐφράιμ τὸν Μαασαίαν τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ βασιλέως
traditions.VUL: Eódem témpore occídit Zechri , vir potens ex Ephraim , Maasíam fílium regis ,
traditions.KJV: And Zichri , a mighty man of Ephraim , slew Maaseiah the king ’s son ,

7.english_reference: and Azrikam the governor of the house

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת עַזְרִיקָ֖ם נְגִ֣יד הַ בָּ֑יִת
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸν Ἐγδρεικὰν ἡγούμενον τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: et Ezricam ducem domus eius ,
traditions.KJV: and Azrikam the governor of the house ,

7.english_reference: and Elkanah [ that was ] next to the king

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת אֶלְקָנָ֖ה מִשְׁנֵ֥ה הַ מֶּֽלֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸν Εἰλκανὰ τὸν διάδοχον τοῦ βασιλέως .
traditions.VUL: Elcanam quoque secúndum a rege .
traditions.KJV: and Elkanah [ that was ] next to the king .

8.english_reference: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁבּוּ֩ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל מֵֽ אֲחֵי הֶ֜ם מָאתַ֣יִם אֶ֗לֶף
traditions.LXX: καὶ ᾐχμαλώτισαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ ἀπὸ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν τριακοσίας χιλιάδας ,
traditions.VUL: Ceperúntque fílii Israel de frátribus suis ducénta míllia
traditions.KJV: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand ,

traditions.WLC: נָשִׁים֙ בָּנִ֣ים וּ בָנ֔וֹת
traditions.LXX: γυναῖκας υἱοὺς θυγατέρας ,
traditions.VUL: mulíerum , puerórum , et puellárum ,
traditions.KJV: women , sons , and daughters ,

8.english_reference: and took also away much spoil from them

traditions.WLC: וְ גַם שָׁלָ֥ל רָ֖ב בָּזְז֣וּ מֵ הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: σκῦλα πολλὰ ἐσκύλευσαν ἐξ αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et infinítam prædam :
traditions.KJV: and took also away much spoil from them ,

8.english_reference: and brought the spoil to Samaria

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבִ֥יאוּ אֶת הַ שָּׁלָ֖ל לְ שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
traditions.LXX: ἤνεγκαν τὰ σκῦλα εἰς Σαμάρειαν .
traditions.VUL: pertulerúntque eam in Samaríam .
traditions.KJV: and brought the spoil to Samaria .

9.english_reference: But a prophet of the LORD was there , whose name [ was ] Oded

traditions.WLC: וְ֠ שָׁם הָיָ֨ה נָבִ֥יא לַֽ יהוָה֮ עֹדֵ֣ד שְׁמ וֹ֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκεῖ ἦν ὁ προφήτης τοῦ κυρίου , Ὠδὴδ ὄνομα ·
traditions.VUL: Ea tempestáte erat ibi prophéta Dómini , nómine Oded :
traditions.KJV: But a prophet of the LORD was there , whose name [ was ] Oded :

9.english_reference: and he went out before the host that came to Samaria

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּצֵ֗א לִ פְנֵ֤י הַ צָּבָא֙ הַ בָּ֣א לְ שֹׁמְר֔וֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν εἰς ἀπάντησιν τῆς δυνάμεως τῶν ἐρχομένων εἰς Σαμάρειαν
traditions.VUL: qui egréssus óbviam exercítui veniénti in Samaríam ,
traditions.KJV: and he went out before the host that came to Samaria ,

9.english_reference: and said unto them , Behold , because the LORD God of your fathers was wroth with Judah , he hath delivered them into your hand

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ הֶ֗ם הִ֠נֵּה בַּ חֲמַ֨ת יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵֽי אֲבוֹתֵי כֶ֛ם עַל יְהוּדָ֖ה נְתָנָ֣ ם בְּ יֶדְ כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἰδοὺ ὀργὴ Κυρίου θεοῦ τῶν πατέρων ὑμῶν ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰουδά , καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὰς χεῖρας ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: dixit eis : Ecce irátus Dóminus Deus patrum vestrórum contra Iuda , trádidit eos in mánibus vestris ,
traditions.KJV: and said unto them , Behold , because the LORD God of your fathers was wroth with Judah , he hath delivered them into your hand ,

9.english_reference: and ye have slain them in a rage [ that ] reacheth up unto heaven

traditions.WLC: וַ תַּֽהַרְגוּ בָ֣ ם בְ זַ֔עַף עַ֥ד לַ שָּׁמַ֖יִם הִגִּֽיעַ
traditions.LXX: ἀπεκτείνατε ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐν ὀργῇ · ἕως τῶν οὐρανῶν ἔφθακεν .
traditions.VUL: et occidístis eos atróciter , ita ut ad cælum pertíngeret vestra crudélitas .
traditions.KJV: and ye have slain them in a rage [ that ] reacheth up unto heaven .

10.english_reference: And now ye purpose to keep under the children of Judah and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen unto you

traditions.WLC: וְ֠ עַתָּה בְּנֵֽי יְהוּדָ֤ה וִֽ ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֔ים לִ כְבֹּ֛שׁ לַ עֲבָדִ֥ים וְ לִ שְׁפָח֖וֹת לָ כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν υἱοὺς Ἰούδα καὶ Ἰερουσαλὴμ λέγετε κατακτήσεσθαι εἰς δούλους καὶ δούλας ·
traditions.VUL: Insuper fílios Iuda et Ierúsalem vultis vobis subícere in servos et ancíllas :
traditions.KJV: And now ye purpose to keep under the children of Judah and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen unto you : [ but are there ]

10.english_reference: [ but are there ] not with you , even with you , sins against the LORD your God ?

traditions.WLC: הֲ לֹ֤א רַק אַתֶּם֙ עִמָּ כֶ֣ם אֲשָׁמ֔וֹת לַ יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי כֶֽם
traditions.LXX: οὐκ ἰδοὺ ὑμῖν μεθ᾽ ὑμῶν μαρτυρῆσαι Κυρίῳ θεῷ ἡμῶν ;
traditions.VUL: quod nequáquam facto opus est : peccástis enim super hoc Dómino Deo vestro .
traditions.KJV: not with you , even with you , sins against the LORD your God ?

traditions.WLC: וְ עַתָּ֣ה שְׁמָע֔וּ נִי
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν ἀκούσατέ μου
traditions.VUL: Sed audíte consílium meum ,
traditions.KJV: Now hear me therefore ,

11.english_reference: and deliver the captives again, which ye have taken captive of your brethren

traditions.WLC: וְ הָשִׁ֨יבוּ֙ הַ שִּׁבְיָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁבִיתֶ֖ם מֵ אֲחֵי כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀποστρέψατε τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν ἣν ᾐχμαλωτεύσατε τῶν ἀδελφῶν ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et redúcite captívos , quos adduxístis de frátribus vestris ,
traditions.KJV: and deliver the captives again , which ye have taken captive of your brethren :

11.english_reference: for the fierce wrath of the LORD [ is ] upon you

traditions.WLC: כִּ֛י חֲר֥וֹן אַף יְהוָ֖ה עֲלֵי כֶֽם
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ὀργὴ Κυρίου ἐφ᾽ ὑμῖν .
traditions.VUL: quia magnus furor Dómini ímminet vobis .
traditions.KJV: for the fierce wrath of the LORD [ is ] upon you .

12.english_reference: Then certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּקֻ֨מוּ אֲנָשִׁ֜ים מֵ רָאשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי אֶפְרַ֗יִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέστησαν ἄρχοντες ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Ἐφράιμ ,
traditions.VUL: Stetérunt ítaque viri de princípibus filiórum Ephraim ,
traditions.KJV: Then certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim ,

12.english_reference: Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai

traditions.WLC: עֲזַרְיָ֤הוּ בֶן יְהֽוֹחָנָן֙ בֶּרֶכְיָ֣הוּ בֶן מְשִׁלֵּמ֔וֹת וִֽ יחִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן שַׁלֻּ֔ם וַ עֲמָשָׂ֖א בֶּן חַדְלָ֑י
traditions.LXX: Οὐδειὰ ὁ τοῦ Ἰωανοὺ καὶ Ζαχαρίας ὁ τοῦ Μοσολαμὼθ καὶ Ἑζεκίας ὁ τοῦ Σελλὴμ καὶ Ἀμασείας ὁ τοῦ Χοάδ ,
traditions.VUL: Azarías fílius Ióhanan , Barachías fílius Mosóllamoth , Ezechías fílius Sellum , et Amasa fílius Adali ,
traditions.KJV: Azariah the son of Johanan , Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth , and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum , and Amasa the son of Hadlai ,

12.english_reference: stood up against them that came from the war

traditions.WLC: עַל הַ בָּאִ֖ים מִן הַ צָּבָֽא
traditions.LXX: ἐπὶ τοὺς ἐρχομένους ἀπὸ τοῦ πολέμου ·
traditions.VUL: contra eos , qui veniébant de prœ́lio ,
traditions.KJV: stood up against them that came from the war ,

13.english_reference: And said unto them, Ye shall not bring in the captives hither

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּאמְר֣וּ לָ הֶ֗ם לֹא תָבִ֤יאוּ אֶת הַ שִּׁבְיָה֙ הֵ֔נָּה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπαν αὐτοῖς Οὐ μὴ εἰσαγάγητε τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν ὧδε πρὸς ἡμᾶς ,
traditions.VUL: et dixérunt eis : Non introducétis huc captívos ,
traditions.KJV: And said unto them , Ye shall not bring in the captives hither :

13.english_reference: for whereas we have offended against the LORD [ already ]

traditions.WLC: כִּי֩ לְ אַשְׁמַ֨ת יְהוָ֤ה עָלֵ֨י נוּ֙
traditions.LXX: ὅτι εἰς τὸ ἁμαρτάνειν τῷ κυρίῳ ἐφ᾽ ἡμᾶς
traditions.VUL: ne peccémus Dómino .
traditions.KJV: for whereas we have offended against the LORD [ already ] ,

13.english_reference: ye intend to add [ more ] to our sins and to our trespass

traditions.WLC: אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֔ים לְ הֹסִ֥יף עַל חַטֹּאתֵ֖י נוּ וְ עַל אַשְׁמָתֵ֑י נוּ
traditions.LXX: ὑμεῖς λέγετε , προσθεῖναι ἐπὶ ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ἡμῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν ἄγνοιαν ,
traditions.VUL: Quare vultis adícere super peccáta nostra , et vétera cumuláre delícta ?
traditions.KJV: ye intend to add [ more ] to our sins and to our trespass :

13.english_reference: for our trespass is great, and [ there is ] fierce wrath against Israel

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי רַבָּ֤ה אַשְׁמָה֙ לָ֔ נוּ וַ חֲר֥וֹן אָ֖ף עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: ὅτι πολλὴ ἡ ἁμαρτία ἡμῶν καὶ ὀργὴ Κυρίου θεοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: grande quippe peccátum est , et ira furóris Dómini ímminet super Israel .
traditions.KJV: for our trespass is great , and [ there is ] fierce wrath against Israel .

14.english_reference: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּעֲזֹ֣ב הֶֽ חָל֗וּץ אֶת הַ שִּׁבְיָה֙ וְ אֶת הַ בִּזָּ֔ה לִ פְנֵ֥י הַ שָּׂרִ֖ים וְ כָל הַ קָּהָֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀφῆκαν οἱ πολεμισταὶ τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν καὶ τὰ σκῦλα ἐναντίον τῶν ἀρχόντων καὶ πάσης τῆς ἐκκλησίας .
traditions.VUL: Dimiserúntque viri bellatóres prædam , et univérsa quæ céperant , coram princípibus , et omni multitúdine .
traditions.KJV: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation .

15.english_reference: And the men which were expressed by name rose up, and took the captives

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּקֻ֣מוּ הָ אֲנָשִׁים֩ אֲשֶׁר נִקְּב֨וּ בְ שֵׁמ֜וֹת וַ יַּחֲזִ֣יקוּ בַ שִּׁבְיָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέστησαν ἄνδρες οἳ ἐπεκλήθησαν ἐν ὀνόματι καὶ ἀντελάβοντο τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας ,
traditions.VUL: Steterúntque viri , quos supra memorávimus , et apprehendéntes captívos ,
traditions.KJV: And the men which were expressed by name rose up , and took the captives ,

15.english_reference: and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them

traditions.WLC: וְ כָֽל מַעֲרֻמֵּי הֶם֮ הִלְבִּ֣ישׁוּ מִן הַ שָּׁלָל֒
traditions.LXX: πάντας τοὺς γυμνοὺς περιέβαλον ἀπὸ τῶν σκύλων ,
traditions.VUL: omnésque qui nudi erant , vestiérunt de spóliis :
traditions.KJV: and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them ,

15.english_reference: and arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them to eat and to drink

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּלְבִּשׁ֣וּ ם וַ֠ יַּנְעִלוּ ם וַ יַּאֲכִל֨וּ ם וַ יַּשְׁק֜וּ ם
traditions.LXX: ἐνέδυσαν αὐτοὺς καὶ ὑπέδησαν αὐτούς , ἔδωκαν καὶ φαγεῖν καὶ ἀλείψασθαι ,
traditions.VUL: cumque vestíssent eos , et calceássent , et refecíssent cibo ac potu ,
traditions.KJV: and arrayed them , and shod them , and gave them to eat and to drink ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְסֻכ֗וּ ם
traditions.VUL: unxisséntque propter labórem ,
traditions.KJV: and anointed them ,

15.english_reference: and carried all the feeble of them upon asses

traditions.WLC: וַ יְנַהֲל֤וּ ם בַּ חֲמֹרִים֙ לְ כָל כּוֹשֵׁ֔ל
traditions.LXX: ἀντελάβοντο καὶ ἐν ὑποζυγίοις παντὸς ἀσθενοῦντος ,
traditions.VUL: et adhibuíssent eis curam : quicúmque ambuláre non póterant , et erant imbecíllo córpore , imposuérunt eos iuméntis ,
traditions.KJV: and carried all the feeble of them upon asses ,

15.english_reference: and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren

traditions.WLC: וַ יְבִיא֛וּ ם יְרֵח֥וֹ עִיר הַ תְּמָרִ֖ים אֵ֣צֶל אֲחֵי הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: κατέστησαν αὐτοὺς εἰς Ἰερειχὼ πόλιν φοινίκων πρὸς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et adduxérunt Iéricho civitátem palmárum ad fratres eórum ,
traditions.KJV: and brought them to Jericho , the city of palm trees , to their brethren :

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּשׁ֖וּבוּ שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
traditions.LXX: ἐπέστρεψαν εἰς Σαμάρειαν .
traditions.VUL: ipsíque revérsi sunt in Samaríam .
traditions.KJV: then they returned to Samaria .

16.english_reference: At that time did king Ahaz send unto the kings of Assyria to help him

traditions.WLC: בָּ עֵ֣ת הַ הִ֗יא שָׁלַ֞ח הַ מֶּ֧לֶךְ אָחָ֛ז עַל מַלְכֵ֥י אַשּׁ֖וּר לַ עְזֹ֥ר לֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: Ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ἀπέστειλεν Ἀχὰς πρὸς βασιλέα Ἀσσοὺρ βοηθῆσαι αὐτῷ .
traditions.VUL: Témpore illo misit rex Achaz ad regem Assyriórum , póstulans auxílium .
traditions.KJV: At that time did king Ahaz send unto the kings of Assyria to help him .

17.english_reference: For again the Edomites had come and smitten Judah, and carried away captives

traditions.WLC: וְ ע֥וֹד אֲדוֹמִ֖ים בָּ֑אוּ וַ יַּכּ֥וּ בִ יהוּדָ֖ה וַ יִּשְׁבּוּ שֶֽׁבִי
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν τούτῳ , ὅτι Ἰδουμαῖοι ἐπέθεντο καὶ ἐπάταξαν ἐν Ἰούδᾳ καὶ ἠχμαλώτισαν αἰχμαλωσίαν .
traditions.VUL: Venerúntque Idumǽi , et percussérunt multos ex Iuda , et cepérunt prædam magnam .
traditions.KJV: For again the Edomites had come and smitten Judah , and carried away captives .

18.english_reference: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country, and of the south of Judah

traditions.WLC: וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֣ים פָּשְׁט֗וּ בְּ עָרֵ֨י הַ שְּׁפֵלָ֣ה וְ הַ נֶּגֶב֮ לִֽ יהוּדָה֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι ἐπέθεντο ἐπὶ τὰς πόλεις τῆς πεδινῆς καὶ ἀπὸ λιβὸς τοῦ Ἰούδα ,
traditions.VUL: Philísthiim quoque diffúsi sunt per urbes campéstres , et ad merídiem Iuda :
traditions.KJV: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country , and of the south of Judah ,

18.english_reference: and had taken Bethshemesh, and Ajalon, and Gederoth, and Shocho with the villages thereof, and Timnah with the villages thereof, Gimzo also and the villages thereof

traditions.WLC: וַֽ֠ יִּלְכְּדוּ אֶת בֵּֽית שֶׁ֨מֶשׁ וְ אֶת אַיָּל֜וֹן וְ אֶת הַ גְּדֵר֗וֹת וְ אֶת שׂוֹכ֤וֹ וּ בְנוֹתֶ֨י הָ֙ וְ אֶת תִּמְנָ֣ה וּ בְנוֹתֶ֔י הָ וְ אֶת גִּמְז֖וֹ וְ אֶת בְּנֹתֶ֑י הָ
traditions.LXX: ἔλαβον τὴν Βαιθσάμυς , τὴν Αἰλὼ καὶ τὴν Γαληρὼ καὶ τὴν Σωχὼ καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Γαλεζὼ καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς ·
traditions.VUL: ceperúntque Béthsames , et Aialon , et Gáderoth , Socho quoque , et Thamnan , et Gamzo , cum vículis suis ,
traditions.KJV: and had taken Bethshemesh , and Ajalon , and Gederoth , and Shocho with the villages thereof , and Timnah with the villages thereof , Gimzo also and the villages thereof :

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּשְׁב֖וּ שָֽׁם
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατῴκησαν ἐκεῖ .
traditions.VUL: et habitavérunt in eis .
traditions.KJV: and they dwelt there .

19.english_reference: For the LORD brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי הִכְנִ֤יעַ יְהוָה֙ אֶת יְהוּדָ֔ה בַּ עֲב֖וּר אָחָ֣ז מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐταπείνωσεν Κύριος τὸν Ἰούδαν δι᾽ Ἀχὰζ βασιλέα Ἰούδα ,
traditions.VUL: Humiliáverat enim Dóminus Iudam propter Achaz regem Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: For the LORD brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel ;

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י הִפְרִ֨יעַ֙ בִּֽ יהוּדָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: eo quod nudásset eum auxílio ,
traditions.KJV: for he made Judah naked ,

19.english_reference: and transgressed sore against the LORD

traditions.WLC: וּ מָע֥וֹל מַ֖עַל בַּ יהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἀπέστη ἀποστάσει ἀπὸ Κυρίου .
traditions.VUL: et contémptui habuísset Dóminum .
traditions.KJV: and transgressed sore against the LORD .

20.english_reference: And Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria came unto him

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹ֣א עָלָ֔י ו תִּלְּגַ֥ת פִּלְנְאֶ֖סֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦλθεν ἐπ᾽ αὐτὸν Θαλγαφελλάδαρ βασιλεὺς Ἀσσούρ ·
traditions.VUL: Adduxítque contra eum Thelgathphálnasar regem Assyriórum ,
traditions.KJV: And Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria came unto him ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֥צַר ל֖ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔθλιψαν αὐτόν .
traditions.VUL: qui et afflíxit eum ,
traditions.KJV: and distressed him ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֥א חֲזָקֽ וֹ
traditions.VUL: et nullo resisténte vastávit .
traditions.KJV: but strengthened him not .

21.english_reference: For Ahaz took away a portion [ out ] of the house of the LORD , and [ out ] of the house of the king , and of the princes

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי חָלַ֤ק אָחָז֙ אֶת בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְ אֶת בֵּ֥ית הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ וְ הַ שָּׂרִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ἀχὰς τὰ ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου καὶ τὰ ἐν οἴκῳ τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ τῶν ἀρχόντων
traditions.VUL: Igitur Achaz spoliáta domo Dómini , et domo regum ac príncipum ,
traditions.KJV: For Ahaz took away a portion [ out ] of the house of the LORD , and [ out ] of the house of the king , and of the princes ,

21.english_reference: and gave [ it ] unto the king of Assyria

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתֵּן֙ לְ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκεν τῷ βασιλεῖ Ἀσσούρ ·
traditions.VUL: dedit regi Assyriórum múnera ,
traditions.KJV: and gave [ it ] unto the king of Assyria :

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֥א לְ עֶזְרָ֖ה לֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ εἰς βοήθειαν αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et tamen nihil ei prófuit .
traditions.KJV: but he helped him not .

22.english_reference: And in the time of his distress

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ עֵת֙ הָצֵ֣ר ל֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ἀλλ᾽ ἢ τῷ θλιβῆναι αὐτόν .
traditions.VUL: Insuper et témpore angústiæ suæ
traditions.KJV: And in the time of his distress

22.english_reference: did he trespass yet more against the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַ יּ֖וֹסֶף לִ מְע֣וֹל בַּ יהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ προσέθηκεν τοῦ ἀποστῆναι ἀπὸ Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: auxit contémptum in Dóminum ,
traditions.KJV: did he trespass yet more against the LORD :

traditions.WLC: ה֖וּא הַ מֶּ֥לֶךְ אָחָֽז
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεύς .
traditions.VUL: ipse per se rex Achaz ,
traditions.KJV: this [ is that ] king Ahaz .

23.english_reference: For he sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus , which smote him

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּזְבַּ֗ח לֵֽ אלֹהֵ֣י דַרְמֶשֶׂק֮ הַ מַּכִּ֣ים בּ וֹ֒
traditions.LXX: Ἐκζητήσω τοὺς θεοὺς Δαμασκοῦ τοὺς τύπτοντάς με ·
traditions.VUL: immolávit diis Damásci víctimas percussóribus suis ,
traditions.KJV: For he sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus , which smote him :

23.english_reference: and he said , Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֗אמֶר כִּ֠י אֱלֹהֵ֤י מַלְכֵֽי אֲרָם֙ הֵ֚ם מַעְזְרִ֣ים אוֹתָ֔ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Θεοὶ βασιλέως Συρίας αὐτοὶ κατισχύσουσιν αὐτούς ,
traditions.VUL: et dixit : Dii regum Sýriæ auxiliántur eis ,
traditions.KJV: and he said , Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them , [ therefore ]

23.english_reference: [ therefore ] will I sacrifice to them

traditions.WLC: לָ הֶ֥ם אֲזַבֵּ֖חַ
traditions.LXX: αὐτοῖς τοίνυν θύσω
traditions.VUL: quos ego placábo hóstiis ,
traditions.KJV: will I sacrifice to them ,

traditions.WLC: וְ יַעְזְר֑וּ נִי
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀντιλήμψονταί μου ·
traditions.VUL: et áderunt mihi ,
traditions.KJV: that they may help me .

23.english_reference: But they were the ruin of him , and of all Israel

traditions.WLC: וְ הֵ֛ם הָֽיוּ ל֥ וֹ לְ הַכְשִׁיל֖ וֹ וּ לְ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐγένοντο αὐτῷ εἰς σκῶλον καὶ παντὶ Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: cum e contrário ipsi fúerint ruínæ ei , et univérso Israel .
traditions.KJV: But they were the ruin of him , and of all Israel .

24.english_reference: And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of God

traditions.WLC: וַ יֶּאֱסֹ֨ף אָחָ֜ז אֶת כְּלֵ֣י בֵית הָֽ אֱלֹהִ֗ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπέστησεν Ἀχὰζ τὰ σκεύη οἴκου Κυρίου
traditions.VUL: Diréptis ítaque Achaz ómnibus vasis domus Dei ,
traditions.KJV: And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of God ,

24.english_reference: and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God

traditions.WLC: וַ יְקַצֵּץ֙ אֶת כְּלֵ֣י בֵית הָֽ אֱלֹהִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατέκοψεν αὐτά ,
traditions.VUL: atque confráctis ,
traditions.KJV: and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God ,

24.english_reference: and shut up the doors of the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּסְגֹּ֖ר אֶת דַּלְת֣וֹת בֵּית יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ἔκλεισεν τὰς θύρας οἴκου Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: clausit iánuas templi Dei ,
traditions.KJV: and shut up the doors of the house of the LORD ,

24.english_reference: and he made him altars in every corner of Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֨עַשׂ ל֧ וֹ מִזְבְּח֛וֹת בְּ כָל פִּנָּ֖ה בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: ἐποίησεν ἑαυτῷ θυσιαστήρια ἐν πάσῃ γωνίᾳ ,
traditions.VUL: et fecit sibi altária in univérsis ángulis Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: and he made him altars in every corner of Jerusalem .

25.english_reference: And in every several city of Judah he made high places to burn incense unto other gods

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ כָל עִ֨יר וָ עִ֤יר לִֽ יהוּדָה֙ עָשָׂ֣ה בָמ֔וֹת לְ קַטֵּ֖ר לֵֽ אלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν πάσῃ πόλει καὶ πόλει ἐν Ἰούδᾳ ἐποίησεν ὑψηλὰ θυμιᾷν θεοῖς ἀλλοτρίοις ·
traditions.VUL: In ómnibus quoque úrbibus Iuda exstrúxit aras ad cremándum thus ,
traditions.KJV: And in every several city of Judah he made high places to burn incense unto other gods ,

25.english_reference: and provoked to anger the LORD God of his fathers

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּכְעֵ֕ס אֶת יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֹתָֽי ו
traditions.LXX: καὶ παρώργισαν Κύριον τὸν θεὸν τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: atque ad iracúndiam provocávit Dóminum Deum patrum suórum .
traditions.KJV: and provoked to anger the LORD God of his fathers .

26.english_reference: Now the rest of his acts and of all his ways , first and last

traditions.WLC: וְ יֶ֤תֶר דְּבָרָי ו֙ וְ כָל דְּרָכָ֔י ו הָ רִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְ הָ אַחֲרוֹנִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ λόγοι αὐτοῦ καὶ αἱ πράξεις αὐτοῦ αἱ πρῶται καὶ αἱ ἔσχαται ,
traditions.VUL: Réliqua autem sermónum eius , et ómnium óperum suórum priórum et novissimórum ,
traditions.KJV: Now the rest of his acts and of all his ways , first and last ,

26.english_reference: behold , they [ are ] written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel

traditions.WLC: הִנָּ֣ ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַל סֵ֥פֶר מַלְכֵֽי יְהוּדָ֖ה וְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: ἰδοὺ γεγραμμέναι ἐπὶ βιβλίῳ βασιλέων Ἰούδα καὶ Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: scripta sunt in Libro regum Iuda et Israel .
traditions.KJV: behold , they [ are ] written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel .

27.english_reference: And Ahaz slept with his fathers

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁכַּ֨ב אָחָ֜ז עִם אֲבֹתָ֗י ו
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκοιμήθη Ἄχαζ μετὰ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Dormivítque Achaz cum pátribus suis ,
traditions.KJV: And Ahaz slept with his fathers ,

27.english_reference: and they buried him in the city , [ even ] in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּקְבְּרֻ֤ הוּ בָ עִיר֙ בִּ יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐτάφη ἐν πόλει Δαυείδ ,
traditions.VUL: et sepeliérunt eum in civitáte Ierúsalem :
traditions.KJV: and they buried him in the city , [ even ] in Jerusalem :
